{"lines": [{"sp": "", "en": "My brother works at a hotel in Kyoto.", "ja": "私の兄は京都のホテルで働いています。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-194-t2-l1_neural2-f.mp3", "c": [["My brother works", "私の兄は働いている"], ["at a hotel", "ホテルで"], ["in Kyoto.", "京都の"]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "He often talks with guests from other countries.", "ja": "彼（兄）はよく外国から来た客と話します。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-194-t2-l2_neural2-f.mp3", "c": [["He often talks", "彼はよく話す"], ["with guests", "客と"], ["from other countries.", "外国から来た"]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "So he studies English and Chinese after work.", "ja": "それで、彼は仕事のあとに英語と中国語を勉強しています。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-194-t2-l3_neural2-f.mp3", "c": [["So he studies", "それで彼は勉強する", 1], ["English and Chinese", "英語と中国語を", 1], ["after work.", "仕事のあとに", 1]]}], "choices": [{"en": "He studies languages.", "ja": "彼は言葉を勉強する。", "audio": "", "c": [["He studies languages.", "彼は言葉を勉強する"]]}, {"en": "He talks with guests.", "ja": "彼は客と話す。", "audio": "", "c": [["He talks with guests.", "彼は客と話す"]]}, {"en": "He visits other countries.", "ja": "彼は外国を訪れる。", "audio": "", "c": [["He visits other countries.", "彼は外国を訪れる"]]}, {"en": "He works at a hotel.", "ja": "彼はホテルで働く。", "audio": "", "c": [["He works at a hotel.", "彼はホテルで働く"]]}], "q": {"en": "What does the girl's brother do after work?", "ja": "女の子の兄は仕事のあとに何をしますか。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-194-t2-q_chirp3-hd-algenib.mp3", "c": [["What does the girl's brother do", "女の子の兄は何をするか"], ["after work?", "仕事のあとに"]]}, "line_kja": "仕事のあとに英語と中国語を勉強しています", "choice_kja": "言葉を勉強する"}

{"lines": [{"sp": "", "en": "My grandparents live in Canada.", "ja": "私の祖父母はカナダに住んでいます。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-194-t5-l1_neural2-d.mp3", "c": [["My grandparents", "私の祖父母は"], ["live in Canada.", "カナダに住んでいる"]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "They usually visit us every summer, but this year they will come in December.", "ja": "彼らはふだんは毎年夏に私たちを訪ねて来ますが、今年は12月に来ます。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-194-t5-l2_neural2-d.mp3", "c": [["They usually visit us", "彼らはふだん私たちを訪ねる"], ["every summer,", "毎年夏に"], ["but this year", "しかし今年は", 1], ["they will come", "彼らは来るだろう", 1], ["in December.", "12月に", 1]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "We're going to go skiing together.", "ja": "私たちは一緒にスキーに行く予定です。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-194-t5-l3_neural2-d.mp3", "c": [["We're going to go skiing", "私たちはスキーに行く予定だ"], ["together.", "一緒に"]]}], "choices": [{"en": "In December.", "ja": "12月に。", "audio": "", "c": [["In December.", "12月に"]]}, {"en": "In summer.", "ja": "夏に。", "audio": "", "c": [["In summer.", "夏に"]]}, {"en": "In January.", "ja": "1月に。", "audio": "", "c": [["In January.", "1月に"]]}, {"en": "Next year.", "ja": "来年。", "audio": "", "c": [["Next year.", "来年"]]}], "q": {"en": "When will the boy's grandparents come this year?", "ja": "男の子の祖父母は今年いつ来ますか。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-194-t5-q_chirp3-hd-algenib.mp3", "c": [["When will the boy's grandparents come", "男の子の祖父母はいつ来るでしょうか"], ["this year?", "今年"]]}, "line_kja": "今年は12月に来ます", "choice_kja": "12月"}

{"lines": [{"sp": "", "en": "Last weekend, my family and I went on a camping trip to a lake.", "ja": "この前の週末、私の家族と湖へキャンプ旅行に行きました。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t1-l1_neural2-f.mp3", "c": [["Last weekend,", "この前の週末", 1], ["my family and I", "私の家族と私は", 1], ["went on a camping trip", "キャンプ旅行に行った", 1], ["to a lake.", "湖へ"]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "We cooked dinner outside and looked at the stars at night.", "ja": "私たちは外で夕食を作り、夜は星を見ました。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t1-l2_neural2-f.mp3", "c": [["We cooked dinner outside", "私たちは外で夕食を作った"], ["and looked at the stars", "そして星を見た"], ["at night.", "夜に"]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "The next morning, my brother and I swam in the lake.", "ja": "次の朝、私の弟と湖で泳ぎました。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t1-l3_neural2-f.mp3", "c": [["The next morning,", "次の朝"], ["my brother and I", "私の弟と私は"], ["swam in the lake.", "湖で泳いだ"]]}], "choices": [{"en": "A camping trip with her family.", "ja": "彼女の家族とのキャンプ旅行。", "audio": "", "c": [["A camping trip", "キャンプ旅行"], ["with her family.", "彼女の家族との"]]}, {"en": "Her brother's birthday.", "ja": "彼女の弟の誕生日。", "audio": "", "c": [["Her brother's birthday.", "彼女の弟の誕生日"]]}, {"en": "A new lake in her town.", "ja": "彼女の町の新しい湖。", "audio": "", "c": [["A new lake", "新しい湖"], ["in her town.", "彼女の町の"]]}, {"en": "Cooking dinner outside with her brother.", "ja": "彼女の弟と外で夕食を作ること。", "audio": "", "c": [["Cooking dinner outside", "外で夕食を作ること"], ["with her brother.", "彼女の弟と"]]}], "q": {"en": "What is the girl talking about?", "ja": "女の子は何について話していますか。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken4/dokkai-01-3-L5-q-v2_chirp3-hd-algenib.mp3", "c": [["What is the girl", "女の子は何について"], ["talking about?", "話しているか"]]}, "line_kja": "湖へキャンプ旅行に行きました", "choice_kja": "キャンプ旅行"}

{"lines": [{"sp": "", "en": "When I was ten, my uncle gave me his old camera.", "ja": "私が10歳のとき、おじが彼の古いカメラをくれました。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t2-l1_neural2-d.mp3", "c": [["When I was ten,", "私が10歳のとき", 1], ["my uncle gave me", "私のおじが私にくれた", 1], ["his old camera.", "彼の古いカメラを"]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "After that, I took pictures of birds and flowers every weekend.", "ja": "それからは、私は毎週末に鳥や花の写真をとりました。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t2-l2_neural2-d.mp3", "c": [["After that,", "そのあと"], ["I took pictures", "私は写真をとった"], ["of birds and flowers", "鳥や花の"], ["every weekend.", "毎週末"]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "Now I'm in the photo club at my high school.", "ja": "今、私は高校の写真部に入っています。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t2-l3_neural2-d.mp3", "c": [["Now I'm in the photo club", "今私は写真部に入っている"], ["at my high school.", "私の高校の"]]}], "choices": [{"en": "When he was ten.", "ja": "彼が10歳のとき。", "audio": "", "c": [["When he was ten.", "彼が10歳のとき"]]}, {"en": "Last weekend.", "ja": "この前の週末。", "audio": "", "c": [["Last weekend.", "この前の週末"]]}, {"en": "When he started high school.", "ja": "彼が高校に入ったとき。", "audio": "", "c": [["When he started", "彼が始めたとき"], ["high school.", "高校を"]]}, {"en": "Last year.", "ja": "去年。", "audio": "", "c": [["Last year.", "去年"]]}], "q": {"en": "When did the boy get the camera?", "ja": "男の子はいつカメラをもらいましたか。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t2-q_chirp3-hd-algenib.mp3", "c": [["When did the boy", "男の子はいつ"], ["get the camera?", "カメラをもらったか"]]}, "line_kja": "私が10歳のとき", "choice_kja": "10歳のとき"}

{"lines": [{"sp": "", "en": "Yesterday was my mother's birthday.", "ja": "昨日は私の母の誕生日でした。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t3-l1_neural2-d.mp3", "c": [["Yesterday was", "昨日は〜だった"], ["my mother's birthday.", "私の母の誕生日"]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "My sister made a cake, and I bought some flowers at the station.", "ja": "私の姉はケーキを作り、私は駅で花を買いました。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t3-l2_neural2-d.mp3", "c": [["My sister made a cake,", "私の姉はケーキを作った"], ["and I bought some flowers", "そして私は花を買った", 1], ["at the station.", "駅で"]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "My mother was very happy and put the flowers on the table.", "ja": "私の母はとても喜んで、花をテーブルの上に置きました。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t3-l3_neural2-d.mp3", "c": [["My mother was very happy", "私の母はとても喜んだ"], ["and put the flowers", "そして花を置いた"], ["on the table.", "テーブルの上に"]]}], "choices": [{"en": "He bought some flowers.", "ja": "彼は花を買った。", "audio": "", "c": [["He bought some flowers.", "彼は花を買った"]]}, {"en": "He made a cake.", "ja": "彼はケーキを作った。", "audio": "", "c": [["He made a cake.", "彼はケーキを作った"]]}, {"en": "He cooked dinner.", "ja": "彼は夕食を作った。", "audio": "", "c": [["He cooked dinner.", "彼は夕食を作った"]]}, {"en": "He cleaned the table.", "ja": "彼はテーブルをきれいにした。", "audio": "", "c": [["He cleaned the table.", "彼はテーブルをきれいにした"]]}], "q": {"en": "What did the boy do for his mother?", "ja": "男の子は彼の母親のために何をしましたか。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t3-q_chirp3-hd-algenib.mp3", "c": [["What did the boy do", "男の子は何をしたか"], ["for his mother?", "彼の母親のために"]]}, "line_kja": "私は駅で花を買いました", "choice_kja": "花を買った"}

{"lines": [{"sp": "", "en": "Last summer, I stayed at a family's house in Canada for three weeks.", "ja": "去年の夏、私はカナダの家族の家に3週間泊まりました。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t4-l1_neural2-f.mp3", "c": [["Last summer,", "去年の夏"], ["I stayed at a family's house", "私はある家族の家に泊まった"], ["in Canada", "カナダの"], ["for three weeks.", "3週間", 1]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "Every morning, I walked to an English school with their daughter, Jenny.", "ja": "毎朝、私は彼らの娘のジェニーと一緒に英語学校へ歩いて行きました。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t4-l2_neural2-f.mp3", "c": [["Every morning,", "毎朝"], ["I walked to an English school", "私は英語学校へ歩いて行った"], ["with their daughter, Jenny.", "その家の娘のジェニーと"]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "We still send e-mails to each other every month.", "ja": "私たちは今も毎月メールを送り合っています。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t4-l3_neural2-f.mp3", "c": [["We still send e-mails", "私たちは今もメールを送る"], ["to each other", "おたがいに"], ["every month.", "毎月"]]}], "choices": [{"en": "For three weeks.", "ja": "3週間。", "audio": "", "c": [["For three weeks.", "3週間"]]}, {"en": "For one week.", "ja": "1週間。", "audio": "", "c": [["For one week.", "1週間"]]}, {"en": "For three months.", "ja": "3か月間。", "audio": "", "c": [["For three months.", "3か月間"]]}, {"en": "For one year.", "ja": "1年間。", "audio": "", "c": [["For one year.", "1年間"]]}], "q": {"en": "How long did the girl stay in Canada?", "ja": "女の子はカナダにどのくらい滞在しましたか。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t4-q_chirp3-hd-algenib.mp3", "c": [["How long", "どのくらい"], ["did the girl stay", "女の子は滞在したか"], ["in Canada?", "カナダに"]]}, "line_kja": "3週間", "choice_kja": "3週間"}

{"lines": [{"sp": "", "en": "Last Sunday, I lost my wallet.", "ja": "この前の日曜日、私はさいふをなくしました。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t5-l1_neural2-d.mp3", "c": [["Last Sunday,", "この前の日曜日"], ["I lost my wallet.", "私は私のさいふをなくした"]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "I looked for it in my room and in the park, but I couldn't find it.", "ja": "私は部屋や公園でさがしましたが、見つけられませんでした。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t5-l2_neural2-d.mp3", "c": [["I looked for it", "私はそれをさがした"], ["in my room and in the park,", "私の部屋と公園で"], ["but I couldn't find it.", "でも私はそれを見つけられなかった"]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "Then, a woman at the library called me.", "ja": "そのあと、図書館の女の人が私に電話してきました。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t5-l3_neural2-d.mp3", "c": [["Then,", "そのあと"], ["a woman at the library", "図書館の女の人が", 1], ["called me.", "私に電話した"]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "I left it there on Saturday.", "ja": "私は土曜日にそこにさいふを置き忘れていたのです。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t5-l4_neural2-d.mp3", "c": [["I left it there", "私はそこにそれを置き忘れた", 1], ["on Saturday.", "土曜日に"]]}], "choices": [{"en": "At the library.", "ja": "図書館に。", "audio": "", "c": [["At the library.", "図書館に"]]}, {"en": "In his room.", "ja": "彼の部屋に。", "audio": "", "c": [["In his room.", "彼の部屋に"]]}, {"en": "In the park.", "ja": "公園に。", "audio": "", "c": [["In the park.", "公園に"]]}, {"en": "At the station.", "ja": "駅に。", "audio": "", "c": [["At the station.", "駅に"]]}], "q": {"en": "Where was the boy's wallet?", "ja": "男の子のさいふはどこにありましたか。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-201-t5-q_chirp3-hd-algenib.mp3", "c": [["Where was", "どこにあったか"], ["the boy's wallet?", "男の子のさいふは"]]}, "line_kja": ["図書館の女の人が私に電話してきました", "そこにさいふを置き忘れていた"], "choice_kja": "図書館に"}

{"lines": [{"sp": "", "en": "I was going to play tennis with my friend this afternoon.", "ja": "私は今日の午後、友達とテニスをするつもりでした。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-202-t1-l1_neural2-d.mp3", "c": [["I was going to play tennis", "私はテニスをするつもりだった"], ["with my friend", "私の友達と"], ["this afternoon.", "今日の午後"]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "But it was rainy after lunch, so we couldn't play.", "ja": "でも昼食のあとは雨だったので、私たちはテニスができませんでした。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-202-t1-l2_neural2-d.mp3", "c": [["But it was rainy", "でも雨だった", 1], ["after lunch,", "昼食のあと"], ["so we couldn't play.", "だから私たちはできなかった", 1]]}, {"sp": "", "en": "Now we are watching a movie at my house.", "ja": "今、私たちは私の家で映画を見ています。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-202-t1-l3_neural2-d.mp3", "c": [["Now we are watching a movie", "今私たちは映画を見ている"], ["at my house.", "私の家で"]]}], "choices": [{"en": "It was rainy in the afternoon.", "ja": "午後に雨が降った。", "audio": "", "c": [["It was rainy", "雨が降った"], ["in the afternoon.", "午後に"]]}, {"en": "He lost his tennis racket.", "ja": "彼はテニスのラケットをなくした。", "audio": "", "c": [["He lost", "彼はなくした"], ["his tennis racket.", "彼のテニスのラケットを"]]}, {"en": "His friend was sick.", "ja": "彼の友達の具合が悪かった。", "audio": "", "c": [["His friend was sick.", "彼の友達の具合が悪かった"]]}, {"en": "He couldn't watch the movie at home.", "ja": "彼は家で映画を見られなかった。", "audio": "", "c": [["He couldn't watch", "彼は見られなかった"], ["the movie at home.", "家で映画を"]]}], "q": {"en": "What was the boy's problem?", "ja": "男の子の困ったことは何でしたか。", "audio": "img/audio/eiken3/dokkai-202-t1-q_chirp3-hd-algenib.mp3", "c": [["What was", "何だったか"], ["the boy's problem?", "男の子の困ったことは"]]}, "line_kja": "雨だったので", "choice_kja": "雨が降った"}
